channel.description: Last 10 notes on ❄️ Pierre Munhoz engineering blog

item.title: Majority Element
item.description: Learn how to solve the Majority Element problem from LeetCode using Python and the Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm. Ideal for coding interviews.

item.title: Pierre Munhoz — Data Engineering, Analytics & More
item.description: Discover the engineering blog of Pierre Munhoz, a freelance Data Engineer. Explore insights on data engineering, analytics, and coding.

item.title: How to backup Airbyte on Google Cloud Storage?
item.description: I found on the airbyte forum how to backup the Airbyte instance to a new instance but I also used this resource to create a backup script of Airbyte.

item.title: What is Boyer-Moore majority vote algorithm?
item.description: Boyer–Moore majority vote algorithm The Boyer-Moore voting algorithm is a clever method to find the majority element in an array (an element that appears more than n/2 times) using O(1) space and O(n) time.

item.title: Efficient & Secure Docker Images: Build Your Own Containers from Scratch
item.description: Master Dockerfile best practices to build efficient, secure & lightweight Docker images. Learn layer caching, image optimization, multi-stage builds and security for faster deployments and robust CI/CD pipelines.

item.title: Docker Third-Party Images: Your Guide to Faster Development and Deployment
item.description: Master the art of using pre-built Docker images effectively. Learn to run databases, create development environments, and use command-line utilities without building everything from scratch. Stop reinventing wheels and start shipping software.

item.title: Docker Data Persistence Explained (and How to Stop Losing Your Data)
item.description: Master Docker data persistence. This comprehensive guide covers volumes, bind mounts, tmpfs, and practical Docker storage patterns to prevent data loss and manage persistent data effectively, even when rebuilding or scaling containers.

item.title: Docker Fundamentals: Your First Steps with Containers
item.description: Learn how to install Docker and master the essential container commands. A hands-on guide for beginners entering the world of Docker.

item.title: Docker Under the Hood: The Linux Magic Behind Containers
item.description: Explore the Linux kernel features behind Docker: namespaces, cgroups, and union filesystems. See how Docker uses them to create isolated, efficient containers.

item.title: Docker 101: What Are Containers and Why They Matter
item.description: What are Docker containers? Learn how they work, why they matter, and how they differ from VMs and traditional servers in modern software development.
